summary: Stop unprovable baseline levels and incomplete managed copies from failing adopters

delivery.outcome: Adopters stop failing on standard requirements they cannot satisfy: baseline no longer demands CI-level conformance the managed workflow never runs, and every managed .governance/docs copy is inventoried for the docs checker.
nonGoals: No new CI jobs for docs or logs conformance.
No change to S4/S5 evidence rules or the standard-pack checker.

architecture.decision: Align the baseline profile with the checkers the adopter workflow runs (worktrees and docs S2, logs only in runtime-service) and derive the managed-copies inventory from the package manifest, guarded by one regression test.
interfaceChanges: baseline profile requirements: worktrees S3->S2, docs S3->S2, logs removed
architecture.rollback: Revert to accepted base 2b2b470ab9c720cc5e613199ee19a60b0715b8c0; adopters keep their pinned release until they re-adopt.

validation.evidence: Inventory equals every .governance/docs projection with source digests; baseline demands no S3+ for packs whose checker the workflow does not run.
